list.title: Mɔgɔw ​​tɔgɔ sɛbɛri
list.searchPlaceholder: Yira ka kɛɲɛ ni baarakɛɲɔgɔn ID ...
list.empty: Sɛbɛri si tɛ bɛn n’o filtɛriw ye.

override.title: Kuntigi ka yɛlɛma
override.hint: Overrides be sɛbɛ tuma bɛɛ n’i ka admin tagamasiɲɛ n’i ka kuun ye - i kana kuma abada.
override.cancelBookingHint: Ka boon lɔ, o b’a yira ko boon n’a ka baara bɔra, o be baarakɛcogo segi baarakɛɲɔgɔn ma ani a b’a to boon lɔbaga be boon lɔ tugun.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Yala i be se ka o booking bɔ wa? A ka komisiyɔn fana be bɔ yen. O be sɛbɛ n’i tɔgɔ n’i ka kuun ye.

detail.disputeOpen: Tigiya kɛlɛ dayɛlɛnin lo o sannikɛla kan - baarakɛɲɔgɔn wɛrɛ ko ale ta lo. A be latigɛ sɔsɔliw ɲɛɛ kan.

cancellation.title: Ɲɛyirali bɔra
cancellation.hint: O booking n’a ka komisɔn be bɔ yen; baarakɛcogo tigiya be kɔsegira baarakɛɲɔgɔn fɛ ani boon lɔbaga be se k’o ɲɛminɛbaga booking tugun.

disputes.title: Tigiya kɛlɛw
disputes.hint: Jɛnɲɔgɔn min ka tɔgɔ sɛbɛra banna k’a kɛ i n’a fɔ sɛbɛ fila, ale be se ka sɔsɔli kɛ ko sannikɛla tigi ye jɔn lo ye. I k’o fan fila bɛɛ lajɛ ani i k’a latigɛ.
disputes.empty: Kɛlɛ tɛ yen n’o lɔyɔrɔ ye.

detail.title: Kɛlɛ {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: O tɔgɔ sɛbɛri min tun be kɛra, u tun tɛ se k’o sɔrɔ.
detail.noteLabel: Sɛbɛri min be desizɔn ɲɛfɔ (wajibi lo)
detail.noteRequired: I ka sɛbɛ dɔ sɛbɛ walisa k’a latigɛ.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} be sannikɛla mara. Kɛlɛ be ban ani foyi wɛrɛ tɛ yɛlɛma.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}} 's lakanali filanan banna sisan ani sannikɛla tɔgɔ sɛbɛra {{partner}} kama i n'a fɔ tɔgɔsɛbɛ kura.
